fields.Name: Course Performance with Enrollment Cohorts
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Show me the top 10 courses by enrollment in a chart. When I click on a course, show me a line chart of completion rates by enrollment quarter. Then let me click on any quarter to see the actual students who enrolled then and whether they completed. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Course Enrollment & Completion Analytics dashboard connects Courses, Course Enrollments, People, and Member Profiles. It features a ranked bar chart of your top courses by enrollment, an interactive line chart tracking quarterly completion rates for the selected course, and a detailed student roster where you can filter by status and click student names to view their profiles.
